title: 奖励与装扮卡片无字透明母版
prompt:
Use case: game-ui-assets. Create ONE coherent production sprite atlas on genuine transparent RGBA background, 1536x1024 landscape if possible, exactly SIX separate hand-painted EMPTY UI card skins, arranged 3 columns by 2 rows. No scene, no page screenshot, no grid lines, no words, no letters, no digits, no logos, no labels. This is an atlas of card states for a Chinese mahjong casual game.
Actual reference images: image 1 mail screen and image 2 team screen are primary style references only (jade green, warm ivory parchment, delicate rounded gold cloud-scroll ornament, soft hand-painted depth). Image 3 is the current mahjong lobby for consistency. Do not copy any text, characters, scenery or widgets from reference layouts.
Every cell has generous transparent isolation, at least 45px transparent gap between assets, no ornament or glow touching canvas edge. Front-facing orthographic UI, absolutely no perspective. Each family has identical outside silhouette and proportions in all three states. High craft and soft restrained ornament, no plastic shine.
TOP ROW, left to right: 1 reward card DEFAULT warm ivory softly rounded rectangular panel, thin warm gold frame, subtle small cloud corners, large clean empty ivory center; 2 reward card CLAIMABLE same geometry with stronger jade-green rim and softly luminous gold highlights, all ornament attached to edge; 3 reward card CLAIMED same geometry with desaturated soft jade-gray/ivory palette and quiet gold edge, calm visually subdued; do not draw a check or any claim stamp.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right: 4 cosmetic display card UNSELECTED, slightly taller rounded rectangle with delicate gold/ivory border and entirely clean empty warm ivory interior; 5 cosmetic display card SELECTED identical silhouette with substantial jade-green edge and tidy warm gold inner rim; 6 cosmetic display card IN USE same silhouette, jade border plus small attached jade-gold round status socket at top-right, empty socket no check mark; leave center empty for separately composited cosmetic art.
All six card centers are filled clean pale ivory (not holes); all surroundings are alpha-transparent. Keep broad centered content areas free of drawings; dynamic captions, item images and buttons are added by game client. Smooth complete alpha edges, no detached particles.

title: 成就与排行徽章透明母版
prompt:
Use case: game-ui-assets. Create ONE coherent production sprite atlas on a genuine transparent RGBA background, 1536x1024 landscape if possible, exactly FIVE isolated illustrated empty badge frames for a Chinese mahjong game. No background, no page screenshot, no grid, no text, no digits, no logos.
Image1 mail screen and image2 team screen are actual primary style references: delicate jade green, warm cream, restrained warm gold, rounded cloud-scroll ornament, finely hand-painted light/shadow. Image3 current mahjong lobby supports style continuity. Borrow only paint/material style, not reference layout, text, scenery or characters.
Layout: top row has TWO badges centered at x=25% and x=75%; bottom row has THREE medals centered at x=17%,50%,83%. Generous transparent gaps, each fully isolated, no parts touching canvas edges, no detached sparkles, all front-facing orthographic.
Top-left: ACHIEVEMENT LOCKED empty circular frame with restrained cloud lobes at sides and a short double-tail ribbon below, muted stone-jade gray and pale gold. Large center is truly alpha-transparent for a separate achievement icon; no lock pictogram.
Top-right: ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED the exact same circular silhouette and short ribbon tails, rich jade green with refined warm gold bevels and small attached jade beads. Large center truly alpha-transparent. More lively than locked, no text or badge symbol.
Bottom-left: FIRST PLACE marker, softly sculpted gold medal shield with small rounded crown, complete attached ribbon tails, gold face intentionally blank and solid; no numeral.
Bottom-middle: SECOND PLACE marker same recognizable shield form with silver face and warm muted gold trim, smaller crown, blank solid face.
Bottom-right: THIRD PLACE marker same shield form with copper-bronze face and muted gold trim, blank solid face.
Medals are distinct gold/silver/bronze at a glance. No fabricated ranks or numbers. Keep broad clean middle areas for native rank numbers. Transparent holes and perimeter must be real Alpha, no white or checkerboard pixels baked in.

title: 背包物品槽四态透明母版
prompt:
Use case: game-ui-assets. Create ONE transparent production atlas of exactly FOUR empty inventory item slot skins, 2 columns by 2 rows on a genuine transparent RGBA square canvas, target 1536x1536. Use the actual attached primary style reference images 1 mail and 2 team, with image3 current mahjong lobby for consistency: rounded hand-painted Chinese Taoist casual game UI, jade green, ivory parchment, warm gold edging, soft cloud-shaped corner ornament. No scene, screenshots, text, letters, numbers, symbols, item illustrations or grid dividers.
All FOUR slots must have the same SQUARE outside silhouette, same scale, same rounded corners and same empty inner area, front-facing without perspective. Exact placement at 25/75% centers, maximum slot size about 500x500, leave generous true-transparent gutters and margins. The interior is a quiet opaque pale ivory field for composited item icons.
TOP LEFT default: warm cream inset square, delicate gold edge, very subtle cloud corner details.
TOP RIGHT selected: same skin geometry, jade-green edge with brighter gold inner line.
BOTTOM LEFT disabled: same geometry, muted warm gray-jade/ivory surface with desaturated pale gold, visibly inactive, no diagonal bars.
BOTTOM RIGHT newly acquired: same geometry, bright jade and warm gold edge, a small attached red-and-gold ribbon folded around upper-right corner (blank, no characters), restrained small highlight confined to border, no detached particles.
Keep corners and complete edge decorations inside each isolated cell, no cropping, no overlapping or touching neighboring assets, no baked shadow rectangle. Real Alpha outside each slot. Preserve clean centered empty usable interior.

title: 教程指引与奖励小图透明母版
prompt:
Use case: game-ui-assets. Create ONE production atlas of exactly SEVEN transparent UI sprites for a Chinese mahjong game. Canvas genuine transparent RGBA, target1536x1024 landscape, clean 4-column x2-row layout with the bottom-right cell EMPTY transparent. Each icon isolated within its cell with wide transparent gutters and full outer margins. No page background, grid, captions, letters, words, digits, watermark or fake checkerboard.
Actual reference image1 mail and image2 team govern style: fine hand-painted jade green/cream and restrained warm gold, rounded soft cloud curls, moderate soft dimensionality, polished small-game UI. Image3 current mahjong lobby for consistency. No characters/scenery from references.
TOP ROW left-to-right:
1 tutorial SPOTLIGHT RING: fine circular jade-gold highlight ring with soft tightly contained pale-gold outer glow, empty fully transparent center, no icon inside.
2 tutorial DIRECTION ARROW: a single thick curved hand-painted jade-green arrow pointing down-right, warm gold border, complete arrowhead and curved tail, easy to read, not a generic flat vector.
3 tutorial STEP MARKER: small circular gold-edged jade medallion with a clean solid blank jade face for native step number, tiny symmetric cloud lobe decoration, no number.
4 tutorial TAP HAND: stylized cute ivory gloved pointing hand with jade cuff and tiny gold cuff edge, index finger pointing upward, complete wrist, no cursor or pointer attached, no click burst, no extra fingers.
BOTTOM ROW left-to-right:
5 tutorial FOCUS FRAME: thin complete square corner-focus outline in jade and gold with four rounded ornamental corners, fully transparent center and sides mostly thin so underlying UI stays visible; no solid background.
6 GENERIC ITEM VOUCHER: one small ivory paper ticket with scalloped ends, soft gold rim, a jade cloud seal WITHOUT words/numbers, slight artistic angle, readable voucher silhouette, no currency, no price.
7 GIFT BOX: one closed small warm gold/ivory rounded rectangular gift box with jade ribbon and tidy bow, two tiny red tassel accents, no labels, clearly collectible reward object.
Bottom-right remains empty. No duplicate object. No detached floating speckles or large halo rectangle. Fully preserved alpha edges and all parts inside canvas.
